Pamela Anderson Discusses Decade-Long Hepatitis C Battle

Actress Pamela Anderson revealed in a speech in Venice that she secretly battled Hepatitis C for a decade. She stated that the treatment "took everything I had in my bank." Anderson shared that she was diagnosed with the liver disease, which can be fatal, and underwent treatment for it. The speech detailed her personal struggle with the illness.
